_doc: Revert-verify mutants for the WIRING of the `query --stats` pruning line in sparql-query.ts (RFC 308a52c3 Д4, phase 4, vault-exodev task c7a94d8e): computed only under --stats in text mode, printed in the SELECT / CONSTRUCT / UPDATE blocks, recorded with the cached answer, printed on a result-cache hit, never failing the answer. Each mutant reddens exactly `expect` (mutant-driver, control 0; W10–W11 — found by the specification review, W12 — by its closing round). `tree`/`subject` are placeholders (§A145).
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/cli/src/commands/sparql-query.ts

W1_select_line_dropped._note: the SELECT block prints no line: every fresh SELECT axis; the hit axes still read what was recorded (S6, S12a–i green). S21 (bug 685d5ffe) reddens too: it reads the «not computed» line of the SELECT block.

W2_construct_line_dropped._note: the CONSTRUCT block prints no line (S10a); its hit still reads the recorded line (S10b green) — that separates W2 from W5.

W3_update_line_dropped._note: the UPDATE block prints no line.

W4_select_not_recorded._note: a SELECT answer is cached without its line: its hit says «not recorded» (S5a/S5b), and the damaged-record axes find no recorded line to damage. S12f–S12i (bug 685d5ffe) redden too: like S12a–e they first assert that the fresh run recorded the line.

W5_construct_not_recorded._note: a CONSTRUCT answer is cached without its line: its hit says «not recorded» (S10b); the fresh line is printed (S10a green).

W6_hit_prints_no_statistics._note: the pre-fix behaviour of a hit (the `return` without statistics, RFC Д4): every hit axis under --stats. S12f–S12i (bug 685d5ffe) redden too: like S12a–e they read the line of the hit.

W7_hit_ignores_recorded._note: a hit never reads what was recorded: «not recorded» after a --stats run. Same set as the module's M10 and the cache's C2 — links of one chain (stored → handed out → checked).

W8_computed_without_stats._note: the analysis runs on every text query (S14a) and its line is recorded: a hit on a plain run's answer says «recorded» instead of «not recorded» (S6); nothing is printed without --stats, so S7 stays green.

W9_failure_fails_the_answer._note: an analysis failure aborts the query instead of becoming the «not computed» line. S21 (bug 685d5ffe) reddens too: it also asserts that the answer survives a failed analysis.

W10_json_runs_the_analysis._note: --stats --output json pays for an analysis it never prints (found by the independent review of the specification).

W11_analysis_on_every_query._note: the analysis runs on every query, printed and recorded only under --stats: 0.2–0.3 s per query on vault-exodev (review measurement) for nothing (found by the independent review).

W12_json_hit_prints_statistics._note: a JSON hit under --stats prints the statistics block after the document: stdout is no longer one JSON document (found by the closing review round).

W13_not_computed_keeps_line_breaks._note: Bug 685d5ffe (LOW-3): the «not computed» line keeps the line breaks of the error message.

W14_not_computed_only_newlines._note: Bug 685d5ffe, closing review (P3): only \n collapsed — \r and U+2028 stay in the line.

W15_not_computed_without_c1._note: Bug 01f1e76a: C1 (CSI U+009B) stays in the «not computed» line.

W16_not_computed_without_ps._note: Bug 01f1e76a: U+2029 stays in the «not computed» line.

W17_not_computed_crlf_ls_only._note: Bug 01f1e76a (review X): only CR, LF, LS collapsed — ESC, CSI and PS stay.
